instruction: Start the video file from my desktop in VLC media player.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to locate and play the desktop video file using VLC. Evaluator checks VLC's HTTP status interface to verify the player is actively playing the correct file (Rick Astley music video).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vlc_playing_info fetches VLC's HTTP status interface and returns the XML status file path
Metric logic is correct: is_vlc_playing verifies both that VLC is in 'playing' state AND that the correct file is playing
Expected value is accurate: file_name matches the actual video file specified in config
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks both playing state and correct file, covering all instruction requirements
Data flow is correct: getter extracts VLC status XML, metric parses it and verifies playing state and file name
Parameter handling is correct: metric function correctly receives and accesses the rules dictionary directly as 'rule' parameter
Robust edge case handling: metric checks multiple XML paths for file information and handles different file path formats
